parts:
Rajarshi,

We're looking into this issue right now.

Thanks for reporting.

-Andy

On Tue, Jan 27, 2015 at 4:50 AM, Rajarshi Bhadra <bhadrar...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,
I have created an app using shiny. It allows the user to upload a data set do calculations and visualization on it and then download the finished output in csv form. The app is running smoothly when run locally from my PC. However when I am trying to upload it, it is throwing an error. I have attached below the log as I am unable to interpret it properly.
